# Bath & Body Works Sugar Plum Swirl Body Cream, 8 oz

## A Festive Scent for the Whole Season

Wrap yourself in the sweet, cozy aroma of juicy sugar plum, holly berry, and fluffy meringue. This body cream brings the spirit of the holidays into your everyday routine.

## Features That Fit Your Routine

The 8-ounce jar offers generous everyday use, and its layered fragrance notes create a warm, festive scent with every application.

## Benefits for Your Daily Self-Care

Apply after your shower to help skin feel soft and smooth while the fragrance adds a seasonal touch to your routine. The generous size lets you keep one on your nightstand, at the sink, and in your bag, so the scent is always within reach.

## A Favorite for Fans of the Classic

If you miss the sugar plum scents you remember, this cream offers a sweet, familiar fragrance that feels like a seasonal favorite.

## Bring the Holiday Spirit Home

Add Sugar Plum Swirl Body Cream to your cart today and make every day feel a little more festive.
